title: organization.membership.removed (v2)
description: A membership was removed. Emitted when a membership is removed by an administrator, by the member leaving, or by connector-scoped deprovisioning. The member's role assignments and group memberships in the organization are deleted (without authorization.role.unassigned events), organization-bound grants and support grants are revoked and owned automation credentials scoped to the organization stop working. Not emitted when a membership expires or when the user account is deleted.

data.description: Event data. All members are identifiers or state, so the minimal and standard payload forms are identical.

authorization_revision.description: The membership's revision counter after this change (memberships.revision). Compare revisions to discard stale, out-of-order events for the same membership.

organization_id.description: Always set for this event type.
